entities.name: Miguel de Oquendo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel de Oquendo y Segura was a Spanish Navy officer. Born in San Sebastián in 1534, he died at sea in 1588 when returning from the Spanish Armada campaign. He was the father of Admiral Antonio de Oquendo.
